title: Multiple Importance Sampling for Guided Speculative Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.33368v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study an extension of the Guided Speculative Inference (GSI) algorithm for test-time-scaling of large language models (LLMs) to a novel setting where an ensemble of smaller LLMs proposes draft reasoning steps which are later verified by a larger base model and a process reward model. Using the established framework of multiple importance sampling (MIS), we introduce weighting schemes to aggregate samples from a diverse collection of proposal distributions. We provide new bounds on the KL divergence from the optimal reward-tilted target distribution and the expected reward degradation, then demonstrate that the well-known balance heuristic is optimal. Compared to GSI with a single well-tuned drafter, combining several diverse LLMs while retaining the same total number of samples maintains competitive pass-at-$N$ downstream performance while being mathematically robust to situations where the support of a single draft model does not cov

translated_title: 面向引导式推测推理的多次重要性采样
translated_abstract: 我们研究了用于大语言模型（LLM）测试时扩展的引导式推测推理（GSI）算法的一种扩展，将其推广到一个新颖的设置中：由多个较小的LLM组成的集成模型提出草稿推理步骤，随后由较大的基础模型和过程奖励模型进行验证。利用已建立的多次重要性采样（MIS）框架，我们引入了加权方案来聚合来自多样化的提议分布集合中的样本。我们提供了关于最优奖励倾斜目标分布的KL散度以及期望奖励退化的新界限，进而证明了著名的平衡启发式方法是最优的。与使用单个经过良好调优的草稿模型的GSI相比，在保持相同总样本数的情况下组合多个多样化的LLM，能够维持具有竞争力的pass-at-N下游性能，同时在数学上对单个草稿模型支持范围无法覆盖的情形具有鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文将引导式推测推理（GSI）扩展到多个小型LLM草稿模型集成的场景，基于多次重要性采样框架提出加权聚合方案，并证明平衡启发式是最优的，从而在保持下游任务性能的同时增强了数学上的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Guided Speculative Inference (GSI) to a novel ensemble setting where multiple small LLM drafters propose reasoning steps, introduces multiple importance sampling weighting schemes for aggregating samples from diverse proposal distributions, and proves the balance heuristic is optimal, achieving competitive pass-at-N performance while being mathematically robust.
